resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and the 1942 and 1952 survey notes name the Arkansas Forestry Commission, so the record keeps it. One lookout index lists the Ouachita National Forest against the same tower. The index gives no reason, so this is a weight-of-sources call rather than a confirmed answer.

notes_for_editor: No staffing, fire, access or visit source found; the story says so. Staircase layout disagrees: Register says a diagonal internal staircase, the 1942 survey description says a stairway in the center. The Forest Lookouts index lists the Ouachita National Forest for this tower, against the Register and NGS (Arkansas Forestry Commission). Build year unknown; tower already described as standing in 1942. Current condition and access rest only on the Register's 2021 site-visit note and 2023 entry. The record has no height; 30.5 m (100 ft) added from the Register and the 1942 survey.
